summary: Ansible gathers facts from Windows hosts much like POSIX hosts, though some facts differ in format or are missing. Run the setup module against Windows hosts to see what is collected.
questions: How do I see what facts Ansible collects from a Windows server?
Are Windows facts the same format as Linux facts?
What command shows gathered facts for my windows group?

answer_card.title: Viewing facts gathered from Windows hosts
answer_card.answer_md:
Windows facts are gathered like on POSIX hosts, but some are in a different format for backwards compatibility or aren't available at all. To see them, run the `setup` module:

```bash
ansible windows -m setup
```
